items.title: Authors Push Back on Publishers' Claims in Anthropic Settlement
items.summary: Authors are resisting attempts by publishers and agents to claim a share of the recent Anthropic settlement, highlighting ongoing disputes over AI and intellectual property rights.

items.title: Travis Kalanick's Atoms Reportedly Entering Robotaxi Market
items.summary: Travis Kalanick's Atoms is rumored to be venturing into the robotaxi business, signaling a potential new competitor in the autonomous vehicle industry.

items.title: Last Translation Benchmark Released on Hugging Face
items.summary: A new translation benchmark, 'Last Translation Benchmark', has been published on Hugging Face, offering a fresh standard for evaluating machine translation models.

items.title: OpenAI Explores Research Acceleration Strategies Internally
items.summary: OpenAI shares insights into its internal approaches and strategies for accelerating AI research and development.

items.title: Google Gemini and Pixel Partner with Football Clubs for Enhanced Fan Experience
items.summary: Google announces partnerships between Gemini, Pixel, and football clubs, aiming to bring fans closer to the game through AI-powered experiences.

items.title: Google Introduces New AI Tools to Evolve Marketing Strategies
items.summary: Google rolls out new AI-powered features for its Ads and Analytics platforms, designed to help businesses optimize and evolve their marketing efforts.

items.title: DRACO: Fine-Grained Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Agent Training
items.summary: Researchers introduce DRACO, a method for fine-grained credit assignment using dynamic rubrics to improve training for long-horizon AI agents.

items.title: CORE: Improving Compositional Reasoning in MLLM Embedding via Reranker Distillation
items.summary: CORE proposes a novel reranker distillation technique to enhance compositional reasoning capabilities in Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) embeddings.

items.title: PACE: Towards Surfacing Hidden Conflicts in User Requests
items.summary: PACE is a new research effort aimed at identifying and surfacing hidden conflicts within user requests, improving the robustness and reliability of AI systems.

items.title: WorldReward: Reward Modeling for Camera-Conditioned World Models
items.summary: WorldReward presents a new approach to reward modeling specifically designed for camera-conditioned world models, crucial for agents operating in visual environments.

items.title: FlashRender: Few-Step Generative Rendering via Camera-Controlled Video MeanFlow
items.summary: FlashRender introduces a method for few-step generative rendering that utilizes camera-controlled video MeanFlow, promising faster and more efficient video generation.

items.title: Dev Log #20: Deleting 180k Lines and Chasing Socket Leaks in OSS
items.summary: A developer shares a detailed dev log about a week spent in open-source development, focusing on significant code refactoring and debugging socket leaks.

items.title: Environment Evolution for Terminal Agents
items.summary: New research explores the concept of environment evolution to enhance the training and capabilities of terminal agents in various simulated scenarios.

items.title: Principia: Relational Physics Tests for Video Models
items.summary: Principia introduces a new benchmark for evaluating video models based on their ability to understand and reason about relational physics.

items.title: Select, Compress, Reinvest: Visual-Token Allocation in Long-Video MLLMs
items.summary: A controlled study investigates effective strategies for visual-token allocation in long-video Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) through selection, compression, and reinvestment.
